# Homework Assignment 2
Exploring patterns of environmental justice

## Import libraries and read data for analyses
```{r}
# Import libraries
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(stars)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r}
# Read in ejscreen data
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "ejscreen", "EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb")) 

# Read in HOLC grade data
holc <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "mapping-inequality","mapping-inequality-los-angeles.json")) |> 
    select(grade)

# Fix holc geometries
holc <- st_make_valid(holc)

# Check if holc crs matches ejscreen
if(st_crs(holc) != st_crs(ejscreen)){
  warning("Coordinate refrence systems do not match. CRS transformed to match HOLC")
  ejscreen <- st_transform(ejscreen, crs = st_crs(holc))
}

# Confirm CRS transformation
if(st_crs(holc) == st_crs(ejscreen)){
    print("CRS matches")
}
```

```{r}
# Read in Bike and Pedesdtrian Crash data
crashes <- read_csv(here::here("data", "SWITRS_LA","Crashes.csv")) |>
    drop_na(POINT_X, POINT_Y) |> 
    st_as_sf(coords = c('POINT_X', 'POINT_Y'), crs = 4326) # CRS specified in the metadata

# Check if crashes crs matches ejscreen
if(st_crs(crashes) != st_crs(holc)){
  warning("Initial coordinate refrence systems do not match. CRS transformed to match HOLC.")
  crashes <- st_transform(crashes, crs = st_crs(holc))
}

# Confirm CRS transformation
if(st_crs(crashes) == st_crs(holc)){
    print("CRS matches")
}
```

## Part 1: Legacy of redlining in current environmental (in)justice

### 1.1 Mapping HOLC neighborhoods in LA County
```{r}
# Filter to Los Angeles County
la_county <- ejscreen |> 
    dplyr::filter(STATE_NAME == "California", CNTY_NAME %in% c("Los Angeles County"))
```

```{r}
# Create color palette for HOLC Grade visualizations
holc_color <- c("A" = "#76a865",
                "B" = "#7cb5bd", 
                "C" = "#ffff00",
                "D" = "#d9838d",
                na.value = "#A9A9A9"
    )
```

```{r}
# Map LA neighborhoods by HOLC grade
tm_basemap(server = "Esri.WorldTopoMap") +
tm_shape(holc) +
    tm_polygons(
        fill = 'grade',
        fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "HOLC Grade", position = tm_pos_out('right')),
        fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = holc_color),
        lwd = 0.5, fill_alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    tm_title("HOLC Grade Designations for LA County Neighborhoods") +
    tm_compass(position = c("left", "bottom")) +
    tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom"))
```

### 1.2 Summarizing data

```{r}
# Join holc grades to ejscreen
ej_by_holc <- st_join(la_county, holc, join = st_intersects) |> 
    st_drop_geometry() |> 
    group_by(grade)   # Group by HOLC grade
```

```{r}
# Find percent of la census blocks in each HOLC grade
summary <- ej_by_holc |> 
    summarize(n_blocks = n()) |> 
    mutate(pct_blocks = n_blocks/sum(n_blocks)*100)

# Convert to kable for rendering
summary[c('grade', 'pct_blocks')] |> 
  kable(col.names = c("HOLC Grade Designation", "Percent of LA Census Block Groups within Grade")) |> 
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped")
```

### 1.3 Visualizing current conditions
```{r}
# Calculate mean % low income by grade
pct_low_income <- ej_by_holc |> 
    summarize(mean_pct_low_income = mean(LOWINCPCT, na.rm = TRUE)*100)

# Calculate mean percentile for PM 2.5
pctl_pm25 <- ej_by_holc |> 
    summarize(mean_pctl_pm25 = mean(P_PM25, na.rm = TRUE))

# Calculate mean percentile low life expectancy
pctl_life_exp <- ej_by_holc |> 
    summarize(mean_pctl_life_exp = mean(P_LIFEEXPPCT, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
# Plot mean % low income
ggplot(
    data = pct_low_income,
    mapping = aes(x = grade, y = mean_pct_low_income)
) + 
    geom_col(fill = holc_color) +
    labs(title = "Average Percent Low Income for LA Census Blocks by HOLC Grade",
    x = "HOLC Grade",
    y = "Mean percent low income"
    )
```

```{r}
# Plot mean percentile for PM 2.5
ggplot(
    data = pctl_pm25,
    mapping = aes(x = grade, y = mean_pctl_pm25)
) + 
    geom_col(fill = holc_color) +
    labs(title = "Average Percentile for Particulate Matter 2.5 of LA Census Blocks by HOLC Grade",
    x = "HOLC Grade",
    y = "Mean percentile for PM 2.5"
    )
```

```{r}
# Plot mean percentile for low life expectancy
ggplot(
    data = pctl_life_exp,
    mapping = aes(x = grade, y = mean_pctl_life_exp, fill = holc_color)
) +
    geom_col(fill = holc_color) +
    labs(title = "Average Percentile for Low Life Expectancy of LA Census Blocks by HOLC Grade",
    x = "HOLC Grade",
    y = "Mean percentile for low life expectancy"
    )
```

### 1.4 Reflection

## Part 2: Legacy of redlining in pedstrian and bike accidents

### 2.1 Percent observations within redlined neighborhoods

```{r}
# Check if crashes CRS matches holc data
if(st_crs(crashes) != st_crs(holc)){
  warning("Initial coordinate refrence systems do not match. CRS transformed to match HOLC.")
  crashes <- st_transform(crashes, crs = st_crs(holc))
}

# Confirm CRS transformation
if(st_crs(crashes) == st_crs(holc)){
    print("CRS matches")
}
```

```{r}
# Filter crashes involving bikes or pedestrians
bike_ped_crashes <- crashes |> 
    filter(PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT == "Y" | BICYCLE_ACCIDENT == "Y")
    
```

```{r}
crashes_in_holc <- st_join(holc, bike_ped_crashes, join = st_intersects) |> 
    st_drop_geometry()
```

```{r}
pct_crashes_by_grade <- crashes_in_holc |> 
    group_by(grade) |> 
    summarize(count = n()) |> 
    mutate(pct_crashes_in_grade = count/sum(count)*100)
pct_crashes_by_grade
```

```{r}
ggplot(
    data = pct_crashes_by_grade,
    mapping = aes(x = grade, y = pct_crashes_in_grade)
) + geom_col(fill = holc_color) +
    labs(title = "Percent of Bike and Pedestrian Crashes in LA HOLC grades",
    x = "HOLC Grade",
    y = "Percent of crash observations within grade"
    )
```
